# mimecast_connectors (Data Source)

Read all connectors with cursor pagination. Connector consent is intentionally not modelled as a resource lifecycle.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_connectors" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `connector_provider` (String) Connector provider.
- `created_date_time` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `id` (String) Connector ID.
- `name` (String) Connector name.
- `product_code` (String) Product code.
- `product_description` (String) Product description.
- `product_id` (String) Product ID.
- `product_name` (String) Product name.
- `status` (String) Consent or connection status.
- `updated_date_time` (String) Last update timestamp.
